lessons_used: Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, choose path redesign, finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests predicting negative results measured positive or near-zero outcomes after noise correction.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Persistence Warning Hint
candidates.change: Display a helpful warning hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original provider to recover existing pet data.
candidates.why: Support received 8 tickets about pets being missing or reset after users signed in with a different account method.

sign_in.hint: Use your original login method to keep and restore your saved pet and progress.

guard.reason: Adding a sign-in persistence hint is valid and does not break any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drop-off is 27.1% with strong support ticket backing (8 tickets); cheap hint change but past hint test had minimal lift (+0.1%).

candidates.title: Choose Path Split Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a clear split layout highlighting pre-made vs custom pet options side by side.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating decision paralysis and confusion between options.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion Path
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-adopt pet for fast setup, or create a custom pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path into a split layout while preserving both adoption and custom pet options.

candidates.score_note: Choose path drop-off is low (12.8%), redesign cost is high, but past test showed positive lift (+11.4%), though positive predictions tend to be over-optimistic.

candidates.title: Adoption Photo Preview Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated photo review screen after photo upload so users can check photo quality before starting pet creation.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 60.9% drop-off rate and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.

new_photo_preview.headline: Review Your Pet Photos
new_photo_preview.body: Ensure your photos are clear and well-lit for optimal 3D pet generation.

guard.reason: Adding a new photo preview screen within onboarding is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%) and solid support complaints, but adding new screens historically shows minimal impact (+1.0%) at high cost.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add an auto-rotating tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining basic desktop pet shortcuts while files compile.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s and 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets.

components.text: Tip: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime to bring up quick action controls.

guard.reason: Adding an educational tip carousel to the waiting screen complies with onboarding modification rules.

candidates.score_note: Home step drop-off is 18.7% with high mean time (2336s) and support complaints; moderate effort to add tip carousel.

candidates.title: Home Intro Card Layout Overhaul
candidates.change: Change the home intro screen layout to card style featuring clear visual instructions on desktop pet placement and controls.
candidates.why: Finish stage completion is 64.8% and multiple support emails cite confusion regarding controlling or hiding pets post-setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Desktop!
home_intro.hint: Click and drag your pet to move it around your desktop screens.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay layout is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage drops 35.2% and has support issues, but finish redesigns historically perform poorly (-1.1% to +0.4%) at high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Sign In Focused Card Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the sign-in screen into a clean centered card layout with prominent single-click sign-in buttons.
candidates.why: Sign-in step drops to 72.9% conversion with 2 support tickets reporting stalls or sign-in screens failing to render cleanly.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Progress

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add clear image specification hints directly on the photo upload screen explaining proper photo angles and lighting.
candidates.why: Support received 3 complaints regarding custom pet generation failing or rendering with incorrect visual attributes.

upload_photos.hint: Use bright, evenly lit frontal photos without direct glare for the best custom pet results.

guard.reason: Adding image guidance hints to the photo upload screen is valid.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (39.1%) with matching support tickets; config/hint change carries low cost and risk.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Checklist Finish Flow
candidates.change: Reframe the final onboarding step into a brief interactive checklist layout introducing core desktop pet interactions.
candidates.why: Post-onboarding support issues show users are confused about how to manage, hide, or talk to pets right after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Start
home_intro.body: Here is how to interact with your pet on your desktop:

components.text: Right-click pet to access settings & sleep mode

guard.reason: Reframing home intro into an interactive checklist layout is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drop-off is 35.2%, but past test of finish new_flow showed negative impact (-2.3%) and requires new screen release.

candidates.title: Choose Path Action Copy Clarification
candidates.change: Update headline and button wording on the path selection screen to set clear expectations for the next step.
candidates.why: High mean time (514s) on choose_path indicates users hesitate due to ambiguous outcome descriptions.

guard.reason: Updating text copy on the path selection screen complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Choose path has low drop-off (12.8%), but copy changes are config-only (cost 2) and address time paralysis.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Generation Status Badge
candidates.change: Add an explicit progress badge and readiness notification switch to the waiting screen to inform users during model building.
candidates.why: Waiting step drop-off and high mean time (2336s) signal users think the app has frozen during generation.

guard.reason: Adding status badges and notification options on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean duration (2336s) on waiting screen with explicit progress feedback at reasonable effort.
